# Security Policy

## A note on scope

This is a small, open-source project maintained by one person in their spare time. The code is fully visible in this repository. We encourage you to review it before installing, and to stay current with updates.

As with any community-built Home Assistant integration, you are trusting code that runs inside your smart home. Please make an informed decision before installing.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security issue, please **do not open a public GitHub issue**. Instead, use GitHub's private [Security Advisory](../../security/advisories/new) feature to report it confidentially.

Please include:

- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept if possible
- Your assessment of the potential impact

I'll do my best to acknowledge reports promptly and resolve confirmed issues as quickly as possible.

## Recognition

Security submissions that result in a fix will be credited by name (or handle, your choice) in the README. Thank you in advance; responsible disclosure makes the whole community safer.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release is actively maintained. If you're running an older version, please update before reporting.
